author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 1.9.3 - the device icon table (1.9.2) now covers 17 categories instead of 11: locks, presence, doors/windows, water, motion, safety, buttons, cameras, shades, climate/HVAC, lighting, security, media, switches, energy, environmental and generic sensors. A device left as unrecognised ("?") can now carry a short freeform note in the Device icons panel, so you can record what it actually is - the note also shows up on that device's map tooltip. The panel also gained Download backup / Restore from file, the same local-file backup already available for External systems declarations.
